To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
production innovation can expand the industrial design space by removing and/or loosenting constraints over product design.
production innovations can expand the design space for industrial design engineers, which in turn, enables more design freedom and more design options.
production innovations can expand the solution space of product designers by removing or loosening constraints on product designs.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question: how do production innovations influence the design space of industrial design engineering?
the interrelationship of industrial design and production innovation(s), and how this can lead to a better understanding of the design space for product designers.
the interplay between product innovation and manufacturing innovation, which has been underexplored in the literature.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
production innovation can contribute to the expansion of the industrial design space.
production innovation(s) is an effective means to increase industrial design space.
production innovations can contribute positively in expanding the industrial design space, and that this can have a significant impact on the design process and the design outcome.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
industrial design engineers can expand their design space with production innovations, and vice versa, manufacturing engineers can expand the solution space with production innovations.
production innovations can expand the industrial design space by providing new design freedom and new manufacturing possibilities, and this can in turn lead to more innovative product designs.
the production innovation can be a new source to expand the solution space of product design engineers, and manufacturing innovation is also a new source to support product innovation.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the industrial design space is not only limited by the available manufacturing system but also by the manufacturing engineers’ capability to innovate and explore new production capabilities to support industrial design engineers in their product design process.
production innovations can be a powerful enabler for expanding the industrial design space and for supporting product design innovation.
production innovations are a source for industrial design engineers to expand their design space and for manufacturing engineers to explore new product opportunities.
